description: SwiftUI view components for rendering and editing configuration schemas and channel configurations within a macOS application.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Recursively renders a configuration schema node into SwiftUI views based on its type.

methods.name: renderStringField
methods.description: Renders a string input field, which can be a text box, secure field, or Picker for enums.

methods.name: renderNumberField
methods.description: Renders a numeric input field, supporting integer and double types.

methods.name: renderArray
methods.description: Renders an array of configuration items with add/remove controls.

methods.name: renderAdditionalProperties
methods.description: Handles rendering of additional properties not explicitly defined in schema.

methods.name: stringBinding
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI binding for string configuration values.

methods.name: boolBinding
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI binding for boolean configuration values.

methods.name: numberBinding
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI binding for numeric configuration values.

methods.name: enumBinding
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI binding for enum options represented as index.

methods.name: mapKeyBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for editing dictionary keys within configuration.
